انغرزوا (form VII)
# اِنْغَرَزُوا (inḡarazū) /in.ɣa.ra.zuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْغَرَزَ (inḡaraza)
# اِنْغَرِزُوا (inḡarizū) /in.ɣa.ri.zuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْغَرَزَ (inḡaraza)
